newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo sells debt portfolio to Morgan.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo sells debt portfolio to Morgan.

text.p: Italy's Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino said it had sold a portfolio of distressed mortgage debt of 480 billion lire nominal value to Morgan Stanley for more than 200 billion lire.
San Paolo said in a statement the portfolio of 2,160 mortgages was valued in the bank's balance sheet at 376 billion lire. The sale was completed on December 31 1996.
San Paolo said the move, which had received the go-ahead from the Bank of Italy, was consistent with the bank's policy of drastically reducing non-performing debt.
